family: Use the total evaluator in proof.md, fixed-logarithmic-family-v2.md Sections 2-5, with its fixed constants and zero guard branch. Its NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness when that P evaluator outputs one.
theorem: This one fixed family satisfies C_B2(f_n)>=4n-K*log2(n) for every integer actual length n>=N0 in native full B2, for fixed K>0,N0. The proof permits K=16H. Its finite projection is (4,1).
